title: Power Rankings: Jazz, Hornets make their move; Heat, Bulls slide
heading: 2006-07 Power Rankings: Week 3
author: Marc Stein

rankings.summaryHtml: How do we know Jazz are reborn? They just posted a 3-0 week without an injured AK-47 and Sloan is handing big roles to kids like Miles, Brewer and Millsap.

rankings.summaryHtml: Lots to be thankful for indeed. Kobe's recovering, Bynum's blossoming and Lakers are only four games (3-1) into a stretch where they play 13 of 14 at Staples Center.
